decision.justification: Selected 'trimmed_mean' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.931. Series context: trend strength 0.9885 and seasonal strength 0.9998; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.099); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.857.
